label: Published AirDrive firmware
whatsNew: New version highlights: OTA firmware updates and firmware checks. Updated game names to reduce any legal/trademark conflicts. Improved AirDrive wake-up process, so less chance of Disk not ready errors during menu loads. The address shown while TS-DOS loads is portacoco.com/airdrive.html. Block-TRS 100 now shows the 1 on the gameplay screen. Chomp-200 now starts after it loads. After Install, the Tandy says Now Press F4=AirDrive or F8=Main Menu. Model 200 game quit and the AIRDRV menu clear are back to the November 16 behavior. Highly recommend you do this update.
note: Application only. Does not include the five virtual disks.
